name: codex-provider-switcher
description: Switch the active model provider for a Codex task without invoking a model.

interface.shortDescription: Switch the provider for the current Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Adds an explicit provider command for switching one task between model providers through Codex Provider Switcher.
defaultPrompt: Use $provider to switch this task to openai.
